bluetooth_confirm.description:
Do you want to set up {name}?

Home Assistant reads this sensor directly over Bluetooth, so readings are live but only update while it is within Bluetooth range. To follow a sensor that is away from Home Assistant, use the Rotarex DIMES SRG integration instead, which gets the readings that the ROTAREX DIMES app uploads.
